metadata..write:
auth != null && (
            !data.exists() ||
            root.child('rooms/' + $roomId + '/players/white/uid').val() === auth.uid ||
            root.child('rooms/' + $roomId + '/players/black/uid').val() === auth.uid
          )

players..write:
auth != null && (
            !data.exists() ||
            root.child('rooms/' + $roomId + '/players/white/uid').val() === auth.uid ||
            root.child('rooms/' + $roomId + '/players/black/uid').val() === auth.uid
          )

boardState..write:
auth != null && (
            (
              !data.exists() &&
              root.child('rooms/' + $roomId + '/players/white/uid').val() === auth.uid
            ) || (
              data.child('turn').val() === 'white' &&
              root.child('rooms/' + $roomId + '/players/white/uid').val() === auth.uid &&
              newData.child('turn').val() === 'black'
            ) || (
              data.child('turn').val() === 'black' &&
              root.child('rooms/' + $roomId + '/players/black/uid').val() === auth.uid &&
              newData.child('turn').val() === 'white'
            )
          )

$moveId..write:
auth != null && (
              root.child('rooms/' + $roomId + '/players/white/uid').val() === auth.uid ||
              root.child('rooms/' + $roomId + '/players/black/uid').val() === auth.uid
            ) && newData.child('by').val() === auth.uid

cardState..write:
auth != null && (
            root.child('rooms/' + $roomId + '/players/white/uid').val() === auth.uid ||
            root.child('rooms/' + $roomId + '/players/black/uid').val() === auth.uid
          )
